checklist.heading: A Truly Memorable Dinner Cruise
checklist.intro: Step aboard for an unforgettable evening on the water, complete with skyline views, great food, and live entertainment.

testimonial.quote: An unforgettable night on the water – the crew went above and beyond and the views of the city were incredible.

closingCta.heading: Ready To Set Sail?
closingCta.body: Reserve your spot today and experience New York City like never before – from the deck of a Skyline Cruises yacht.

directions.intro: Liberty Landing Marina is easily accessible by car or public transit.

routes.directions: Take the Holland Tunnel to NJ-78, then follow signs to Liberty State Park.

routes.from: From New Jersey and Upstate New York
routes.directions: Take the NJ Turnpike South to Exit 14B, then follow signs to Liberty State Park.
